description: This source file defines a PHP class 'Parser' with methods for parsing system information such as PCI devices, filesystems, and hardware components by executing system commands and processing their output.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A class providing methods to parse system hardware and filesystem information on a system, including PCI devices, PCiconf data, and filesystem usage.

methods.name: parse_lspci
methods.description: Executes the 'lspci' command, processes its output to extract device names, and returns an alphabetically sorted list of device names.

methods.name: parse_pciconf
methods.description: Executes 'pciconf' with verbose output, parses vendor and device information, and returns an sorted array of results.

methods.name: parse_filesystems
methods.description: Runs 'df' and 'mount' commands to gather filesystem usage and mount point information, processes and filters results, and returns an array with filesystem details.
